items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Bar screening;
The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Aerated grit removal;
The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Primary clarification;

The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Pure oxygen aeration; ... The aeration process at the Facility was designed to handle high and variable biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) loadings...
The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Secondary clarification;

The treatment system at the Facility consists of the following: ... Chlorine gas disinfection; and, Dechlorination (using sodium bisulfite prior to discharge to the Feather River at Discharge Points 001, 003, and 004).
Dechlorination (using sodium bisulfite prior to discharge to the Feather River at Discharge Points 001, 003, and 004).
A polyammonium phosphate dosing program was put in place to help balance the influent wastewater nutrient ratio... As of adoption of this Order, polyammonium phosphate was last used in October 2022.
Biosolids are thickened using rotary drum thickeners and then anaerobically digested in two digesters.
Biosolids are thickened using rotary drum thickeners and then anaerobically digested in two digesters.
Digested biosolids are dewatered by 3 screw presses and disposed of off-site as landfill cover material.

The Facility is equipped with three composite bed biofilters that are used to control odors from headworks, primary clarification, and dewatering building operations.
Treated effluent may also be directed to Discharge Point 002, a series of six disposal ponds located within the Feather River levee.
The side-stream treatment system would provide ammonia treatment to return water from the dewatering equipment before returning to the influent.

Anaerobic digesters are cleaned approximately every five years, and biosolids residue scraped from the inside of the digesters is stored in one of the former drying beds, which has a honeycomb type of underdrain directed back to the headworks, until disposal. The drying beds are not used except to dry residue from the digesters when they are cleaned every 5 years.
